**Finding: LICENSE — compliant (preferred level).** No redline proposed.

The licence bargain in §13 (read with §§14.3 and 24) satisfies every preferred element:

- **Affiliates** — §13.1 grants to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf"; §13.2 likewise grants to "Customer and its Affiliates". No written-notice gating is needed, so the fallback notice mechanic is unnecessary.
- **Contractors acting on Customer's behalf** — expressly named in §13.1; §13.2 also permits contractors to support paid-up material.
- **Paid-up perpetual / irrevocable** — §13.2: "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence", extended to embedded Vendor Technology by §14.3.
- **Subscription licence terminable only for uncured material breach** — §13.3 bars revocation or suspension "except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure"; §10.1 preserves paid-up licences after termination.
- **Transferable to successors** — §13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor per §24, and §24.1 allows Customer assignment without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or M&A successor; §24.4 blocks Vendor repricing/termination on Customer change of control.

§13.4's use restrictions are narrow and carve out authorized security testing and use of Customer Data and output, so they do not erode the grant.
